**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 18:48  
[FACT] User is experiencing eye strain from staring at their computer screen all day.  
[EVENT] User is looking for recommendations on blue light blocking glasses.  
[EVENT] User recently purchased a humidifier for their bedroom for $50 from Bed Bath & Beyond, which has been helping with their sinuses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended blue light blocking glasses include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Warby Parker Blue Light Glasses: Starting at $95, with a home try-on program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Felix Gray Blue Light Blocking Glasses: Starting at $95, with a home try-on program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Gunnar Optiks Blue Light Blocking Glasses: Starting at $55, designed for gamers and computer users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Uvex Skyper Blue Light Blocking Glasses: Starting at around $15, more affordable but less stylish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Swannies Blue Light Blocking Glasses: Starting at $69, focused on gaming and computer use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considerations for choosing glasses include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Prescription vs. Non-Prescription options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lens material (Polycarbonate or Trivex vs. glass).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Blue light blocking percentage (at least 90% in the 400-450nm range).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Style and comfort of the glasses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that Warby Parker offers a home try-on program for prescription glasses, including blue light blocking lenses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Warby Parker allows trying up to 5 frames at home for free.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Felix Gray offers a home try-on program for prescription glasses, allowing up to 3 frames.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gunnar Optiks has a "Risk-Free Guarantee" for prescription glasses, allowing a 30-day trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Zenni Optical allows designing glasses with prescription lenses but does not have a traditional home try-on program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] EyeBuyDirect has a home try-on program limited to non-prescription lenses but offers a 14-day return policy for prescription glasses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Warby Parker's blue light blocking lenses are available in most frames, but not all.
